name: Go Digit General Insurance Ltd
title: Go Digit General Insurance Ltd - 544179 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Digit reports FY26 IndAS-basis post-tax ROE of 17.7% and combined ratio 105.7%, but gross loss ratios are stable and motor OD loss ratio is rising amid retention cut to 89.6% from 95.9%.

triggers.label: Motor market price and commission correction in April
triggers.quote: we are seeing in the month of April, some correction which is happening in the market, both on the price as well as on the commission

triggers.label: Motor retention 95.9% → 89.6%
triggers.quote: Overall retention in motor this year is 89.6% compared to 95.9%

triggers.label: Motor OD loss ratio rising, corrective action from July
triggers.quote: from July quarter, we should see some impact

triggers.label: Q4 GWP growth 6.2%; ex-health 18.8%
triggers.quote: the overall growth rate on GWP would still be about 18.8%

guidance.quote: this specialized line of business are capable of giving Digit about INR1,000 crores premium in the next three to five years

guidance.value: not to rise vs last year
guidance.quote: we would try and drive ourselves with the loss ratios in a manner that overall motor loss ratio doesn't go up this year compared to last year
We had said that over the next 2 years, we would expect it to be about 5.
Next year, the tax rate would move to 25.2% basis.

red_flags.label: Net fire loss ratio up on two large claims
red_flags.quote: Fire, we have seen the net loss ratio to go up. But when we -- because some two major claims came.

red_flags.label: Health reinsurance loss ~INR252 crores in Q4
red_flags.quote: the loss in case of health has been about INR252 crores

red_flags.label: Equity allocation rising with solvency-based headroom

evasions.topic: Future motor price/commission outlook and new venture size
evasions.quote: we don't give any sort of a guidance because our experience is that whatever guidance you give
I have not spoken to them on this.
there is no news as such in terms of what the next steps are or the time frame
